title: Unsupported causal link
analysis: A connective added for fluency can introduce a causal claim absent from the source.
nextStep: Require each added causal relation to be supported by a source span; otherwise preserve the two statements without a causal connector.
originalQuote: A local inventory may also contain outdated boundaries.
candidateQuote: A local inventory might contain outdated boundaries, as no field measurements have been collected for this proposal [S1].
finding: Adds an unsupported causal connection: the absence of field measurements for this proposal does not explain whether the inventory boundaries are outdated.

proposedPatchesForThisFinding.before: , as no field measurements have been collected for this proposal [S1]

title: Modality strengthened
analysis: A possible trade-off becomes a promised consequence.
nextStep: Compare the scope of modal verbs in addition to surface grammar, and reject unsupported increases in certainty.
originalQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer while leaving a less complete map.
candidateQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer, but it will leave a less complete map.
finding: Changes a possible tradeoff into a definite prediction that the map will be less complete.

title: Valid deletion rejected by the repair schema
analysis: The model proposed removing an unsupported clause, but an empty replacement fails the current nonempty-after constraint.
nextStep: Permit deletion patches when a unique exact anchor, coverage bound and post-edit semantic audit all pass; test this change on separate data.
originalQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer while leaving a less complete map. A local inventory may also contain outdated boundaries. The proposed experiment will therefore not estimate annual retreat rates or establish that any particular glacier is shrinking [S2]. Its contribution would be a more explicit account of what the available images can support.
candidateQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer, but it will leave a less complete map. A local inventory might contain outdated boundaries, as no field measurements have been collected for this proposal [S1]. The proposed experiment will not estimate annual retreat rates or establish that any particular glacier is shrinking [S2]. Instead, its contribution will be a more explicit account of what the available images can support.

proposedDeletion.before: , as no field measurements have been collected for this proposal [S1]

action: The complete patch set was rejected because one replacement was empty. The original section was restored; changes in the other sections remained eligible.

title: Bias mitigation presented as a guarantee
analysis: Retaining difficult days reduces one selection risk but cannot guarantee accurate reliability estimates.
nextStep: Preserve the qualified relationship between the procedure and the risk it addresses.
originalQuote: We will preserve instances of service disruption, since removing difficult days could make the policy appear more dependable than it is.
candidateQuote: We will retain instances of service disruption to ensure the policy's reliability is accurately reflected.
finding: Retaining disruptions helps avoid an overly favourable assessment but cannot ensure accurate reliability estimates. The revision replaces a qualified bias concern with an unsupported guarantee.

proposedPatchesForThisFinding.before: to ensure the policy's reliability is accurately reflected
proposedPatchesForThisFinding.after: , since removing difficult days could make the policy appear more dependable than it is

action: A bounded repair was applied and the revised section was retained after the final automated audit.

title: Grammar worsens during naturalization
analysis: The revision combines two incompatible comparative constructions.
nextStep: Check local grammar independently of lexical simplification; keep the original construction when the change is not an improvement.
originalQuote: may care as much about an unusually long delay as they do about a typical journey
candidateQuote: may care equally about an unusually long delay as they do about a typical journey
finding: “Equally about ... as they do about” is an awkward comparative construction. Retain “as much about ... as” or use “equally about ... and ...”.
action: A bounded repair was applied and the revised section was retained after the final automated audit.

title: Concrete evaluation safeguard omitted
analysis: A general promise of neutrality replaces the explicit restriction against selecting a favourable threshold definition.
nextStep: Represent fixed methodological safeguards as content commitments, not removable stylistic detail.
originalQuote: Sensitivity checks will vary the definition of a long wait without selecting the definition that most favours either policy.
candidateQuote: Sensitivity checks will vary the definition of a long wait without favouring either policy.
finding: The revision removes the explicit commitment against selecting the most favourable definition. A general promise of neutrality does not preserve this concrete safeguard against selective reporting.

proposedPatchesForThisFinding.after: without selecting the definition that most favours either policy

action: A bounded repair was applied and the revised section was retained after the final automated audit.

title: Temporal scope altered
analysis: A rule fixed before observation is rewritten as a rule maintained only until observation starts.
nextStep: Check temporal connectors as relations, because the same nouns and numbers do not guarantee the same commitment.
originalQuote: These roles will remain fixed before observation begins.
candidateQuote: These roles will be maintained until observations begin
finding: “Until” implies that the commitment to fixed outcome roles ends when observation begins, weakening the prespecified outcome hierarchy.

proposedPatchesForThisFinding.before: These roles will be maintained until observations begin
proposedPatchesForThisFinding.after: These roles will be fixed before observations begin and remain fixed throughout the study

action: A bounded repair was applied and the revised section was retained after the final automated audit.

title: Conservative whole-document rejection
analysis: The auditor distinguishes a reporting commitment from a close statement about test limitations; the entire candidate is consequently rejected.
nextStep: Obtain human equivalence labels for borderline cases and calibrate the rejection policy; this observation is a possible over-rejection, not a confirmed false positive.
originalQuote: Tests will check the supplied examples, but passing them will not be presented as proof that a program is correct for every input [S1].
candidateQuote: While tests will verify the supplied examples, passing them does not guarantee the program's correctness for all inputs [S1].
finding: The candidate preserves the limitation of testing but omits the explicit commitment not to present passing tests as proof of correctness for every input.
action: The final audit rejected the complete candidate. Under the standard policy, no additional full-audit repair round is allowed; the original manuscript was retained.

title: Assessor role changed
analysis: An editorial simplification shifts the stated assessor from an editor to the study authors.
nextStep: Preserve who performs each action, especially when review responsibilities are part of the design.
originalQuote: They will not be counted as unnecessary hedging when an editor assesses whether a revision is more concise.
candidateQuote: We will consider these qualifications as integral content and not count them as unnecessary hedging when assessing conciseness.
finding: The revision removes the explicit role of an editor in assessing conciseness and instead assigns the assessment to the authors. Preserve the specified assessor.

proposedPatchesForThisFinding.after: when an editor assesses whether a revision is more concise

action: A bounded repair was applied and the revised section was retained after the final automated audit.

title: Controlled comparison overinterpreted
analysis: Holding one factor fixed is rewritten as establishing the sole cause of any observed difference.
nextStep: Separate the factor controlled by the design from the causal conclusion that the evidence would support.
originalQuote: This isolates the effect of correction from a change in alert policy.
candidateQuote: This design ensures that any changes in alert counts are attributable to the correction process rather than alterations in the alert policy.
finding: The revision strengthens a controlled comparison into a blanket causal guarantee. A fixed threshold rules out threshold changes as an explanation but does not establish that any change in alert counts must result from correction.

proposedPatchesForThisFinding.before: This design ensures that any changes in alert counts are attributable to the correction process rather than alterations in the alert policy.
proposedPatchesForThisFinding.after: This isolates the effect of correction from a change in alert policy.

action: A bounded repair was applied and the revised section was retained after the final automated audit.

title: Citation scope expanded
analysis: A citation is attached to additional limitations that are not stated in that source packet.
nextStep: Check the proposition supported by each citation occurrence rather than only whether the identifier is allowed.

candidateQuote: A reference instrument can itself have errors, and the study covers only a limited observation period [S1].
finding: The added citation attributes reference-instrument error and the limited observation period to S1, which states neither.

candidateQuote: Difficult days will remain in the overall results.

proposedPatchesForThisFinding.after: Difficult days will remain in the overall results [S2].

title: Dangling modifier introduced
analysis: The rewritten clause grammatically assigns calculation to the recovered material rather than to the researchers.
nextStep: Check the actor of a shortened clause; a concise sentence is not automatically a coherent sentence.
finding: The implied subject of 'calculating' is the recovered output, creating an awkward modifier. Retain the passive clause or explicitly identify who calculates the measures.
action: A bounded repair was applied and the revised section was retained after the final automated audit.

title: Equivalent numeric wording rejected
analysis: Changing 18 to eighteen preserves the quantity but removes a digit token. The lexical gate rejects this valid paraphrase even though the semantic auditor accepts it.
nextStep: Normalize equivalent number expressions before comparing quantities and retain role-sensitive semantic checks for swapped values.
finding: The digit token 18 is absent after a meaning-preserving conversion to eighteen.
action: The deterministic guard rejects the valid paraphrase. The semantic checker accepts it, but their conjunction retains the false rejection.
